messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Plot Showing up as Broken Image
parts:
I have an application where plots are produced using the submit button.  Recently this has caused the area of the plot to show up as a 'broken picture error' in the browser.  Once the submit button is pressed the plot is produced and everything is fine.  See:

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/dbets/dBETS/

This hasn't happened in the past and I haven't changed the code in some time.  Any ideas?

library(shiny)
library(shinyIncubator)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
    h3("Hello"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("Page", strong("Navigate"),list('One'=1,'Two'=2),selected=1),br(),
    
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==1",
      br(),
      actionButton('restart',strong('Reset')),             
      br(),br(),
      wellPanel(                
      checkboxInput(inputId= "dataSource", label="Use a file stored on my local machine.", value=FALSE)
    )),
    
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==2",
      br(),
      wellPanel(
      ### first panel
      conditionalPanel(condition="input.panel==1",

        ############# TEST!!! #################

        h5(strong('Can I see this?')))
    ))
   
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==1"),           
    
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.Page==2",
      tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("One", list(br()),value=1),
      id='panel'
      ))
    )
))
